import copy, json, subprocess, sys, os
root = sys.argv[1]; s = os.path.join(root, ".scratch")
L = json.load(open(os.path.join(root, "ledger.json")))
def run(tag, mutate):
    d = copy.deepcopy(L); mutate(d)
    i, o = os.path.join(s, tag + ".json"), os.path.join(s, tag + ".res.json")
    json.dump(d, open(i, "w"))
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", os.path.join(root, "analyze.py"), "--input", i, "--output", o], check=True)
    r = json.load(open(o))["scenarios"]
    for n, sc in r.items():
        print(tag, n, [m["closing_cash_cents"] for m in sc["months"]], sc["minimum_cash_cents"], sc["financing_to_reserve_cents"])
def defer_all(d):
    [t for t in d["transactions"] if t["id"] == "principal"][0]["cash_period"] = "2026-04"
def defer_30k(d):
    p = [t for t in d["transactions"] if t["id"] == "principal"][0]; p["amount_cents"] = 4000000
def double_count(d):
    d["transactions"][-1]["id"] = "invoice-jan-dup"
run("defer_all", defer_all); run("pay_40k_in_feb", defer_30k); run("double_count", double_count)
EOF
